short_description: Whit's Frozen Custard, founded in 2003 in Granville, Ohio, is opening a new location at 5147 Ocean Blvd on Siesta Key. It is the first of several planned locations from the Fineberg family.

location: 2286 Alyssa Way, Suite 105, New Braunfels, TX 78123
status: construction is expected to begin in September 2026 and conclude by November 2026
short_description: Little Caesars is planning a new 1,200-square-foot restaurant at 2286 Alyssa Way, Suite 105, in New Braunfels, per Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation filings. The estimated project cost is $250,000, with Rene Jackson listed as tenant.

La Michoacana, a Haines City-based Mexican ice cream chain, has submitted plan review paperwork for a new location at 198 Melton Ave in Auburndale. The site is near Wawa, Salem's Fresh Eats, Taco Bell, and Domino's Pizza.

location: 3011 W Yamato Rd, Boca Raton, FL 33496
short_description: Pepe's Cantina is opening its eighth full-service location at 3011 W. Yamato Road in Boca Raton, at the former Lucille's space, marking its first Palm Beach County location. Founded in 2015 by Frank Chavez, the chain has begun hiring for the new site.

Sana'a Café is opening a new Orange County location at 12212 Brookhurst Street in Garden Grove, confirmed by founder Sadeq Alaqel. The Middle Eastern-inspired cafe already has locations in Los Angeles.

status: set to open later this summer
short_description: Cay Bar & Grill is a new Vietnamese restaurant and bar from Khoa Tran taking over the former McCormick & Schmick's Harborside space in RiverPlace. An August or September opening is being targeted.

location: 304 W. Grand Ave., Suite C, Yoakum, TX 77995
status: construction expected to begin in May 2026 and wrap up by October 2026
short_description: Domino's Pizza is planning a new 2,125-square-foot restaurant in Yoakum with a $200,000 interior build-out per Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation filings. Tenant is Tim McBride; property owned by LOBO Street LLC.

location: 1432 W. San Carlos St., Suite 70, San Jose, CA 95126
status: An official opening date has not yet been announced
short_description: Hijau is an Indonesian-inspired specialty coffee concept from Lisa Maria and Ryan Prawiradjaja opening its first permanent café in San Jose. It began as the South Bay's first Indonesian specialty coffee pop-up in 2024.

location: The Switchyard, NE corner of Ellsworth Loop Road and Ocotillo Road, Queen Creek, AZ
status: An opening date has not yet been announced
short_description: Salt & Straw, the Portland-founded ice cream brand, is planning its fourth Arizona shop at The Switchyard mixed-use development in Queen Creek. It will join tenants including Postino, Shake Shack, Snooze, and Bamboo Sushi.

Diner 24, the "Diner 2.0" concept from Stratis Morfogen and Philippe Olivier Bondon (Brooklyn Chop House, Brooklyn Dumpling Shop), is opening a two-story Theater District flagship at 1674 Broadway. It follows the success of the Gramercy location.

location: 4000 Baldwin Rd (Great Lakes Crossing Outlets), Auburn Hills, MI 48326
status: renovations are underway; may be sometime next month
short_description: Don Patron is a Mexican restaurant opening its second location inside Great Lakes Crossing Outlets in Auburn Hills. The first location is in Sterling Heights; co-owner Gustavo Torres did not confirm a firm opening date.

status: An opening date has not been announced
short_description: PopUp Bagels, the "Grip, Rip & Dip" bagel brand founded in 2020 in Westport, CT, is planning a new Brickell location. It now operates about 40 locations nationwide, including eight in Florida.

status: An opening timeline has not yet been announced
short_description: Elevate Coffee, founded by Chloey and Ryan Wilson, secured a commercial building permit for a downtown Nashville café interior build-out. It expands the brand from its Hermitage flagship and locations in Donelson and Lebanon.

status: recently filed permit; opening timeline pending
short_description: Muse Paintbar is bringing its paint-and-sip experience to Inman Park in a 3,084-square-foot space with paint studios, kitchen, and bar area. It will be the brand's second Atlanta location, joining The Battery spot.

status: set to become Harry Hare's; liquor license transfer approved
short_description: Harry Hare's is a new English-inspired fine-dining restaurant with Indian influences from veteran restaurateur Patrick Lyons, taking over the former Beacon Hill Pub space. The Boston Licensing Board approved the liquor license transfer.

Crystola Roadhouse, the historic mountain venue near Woodland Park, is under new ownership by Holly, Shelton, and Steven Ellis, introducing Southern-inspired dishes and entertainment. This is an ownership transfer rather than an opening/closing event.

status: will open at 1601 Walnut St. this fall
short_description: Somedays Bakery, founded by Peter Phillips and known for hand-laminated croissants, is opening its first Philadelphia location as a franchise operated by Dino Porfyris. The brand currently operates five locations across NY and NJ.

status: expected to open with the luxury hotel in late 2027
short_description: Ten Five Hospitality will debut three original F&B concepts — a signature ground-floor restaurant, all-day café/lobby bar, and rooftop garden restaurant — at Pendry Nashville in Paseo South Gulch. The hotel will feature 180 rooms and 146 branded residences by SomeraRoad and TrestleStudio.

status: on track to open in October
short_description: Britt's Donut Shop, the family-owned Carolina Beach donut shop founded in 1939, is opening its first Charleston location this fall. Owner Melinda Nivens Prusa announced the expansion on Instagram.

status: signed agreements to open this fall
short_description: Slutty Vegan, the plant-based burger chain founded by Aisha "Pinky" Cole Hayes in Atlanta in 2018, is entering Ohio with Columbus as one of its first markets. Expansion is being led by Ohio-based Soul Republic Hospitality Group.

status: signed agreements to open this fall
short_description: Slutty Vegan, the plant-based burger chain founded by Aisha "Pinky" Cole Hayes, is opening a Cleveland location as part of its Ohio debut. Expansion is led by Soul Republic Hospitality Group.

status: will permanently close; last dinner on August 1
short_description: Osteria, a family-owned Italian restaurant known for scallops, meatballs, and fettuccine Alfredo, is permanently closing after 21 years. Owner Roberto cited retirement in the announcement.

location: 9287 Wayne Road (Wayneport shopping center), Romulus, MI 48174
status: lease was signed; space recently acquired
short_description: Humble Kitchen is a new 1,200-square-foot ice cream and coffee shop from local Tiffany White in the Wayneport shopping center. It will share the building with China Chef and Romulus Beauty Supply, in space formerly occupied by Lizzy Lit Hookah.

Penn Station Sandwiches is bringing East Coast-style subs to Myrtle Beach with two new locations led by franchisee Eric Fairbanks in partnership with Sait Perez. This is the first of two planned locations in the market.

Gwynne is a chef-driven American restaurant from Executive Chef Brad Bernstein opening inside the Fidelity Hotel in the historic Gwynne Building. It will serve breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch daily.

location: 1485 Dupont Street (Clock Factory Building), Toronto, ON M6P 3S2
status: expected to open later in Fall 2026
short_description: Bottega Volo is opening a second Toronto location as an Italian café, bottle shop, and specialty food retailer in Junction Triangle, moving into space behind the recently closed Pizzeria Defina. It will also serve as headquarters for the Keep6 Imports business.

Sprout & Bean is a play café combining an artisan coffee shop with an indoor playground at 965 Vineland Road in Winter Garden, Florida. It features locally roasted Prairie House coffee, buttermilk bakery goods, and a play area with a tiny village, climbing structures, carousel, and ball pit.

status: set to join The Jesse mixed-use development
short_description: 51st Deli, founded by Carim Yafai in 2018, is opening a new East Nashville location at 730 Main Street inside The Jesse, a mixed-use development by Richland Building Partners. The menu features breakfast/lunch sandwiches, tacos, a salad bar, fresh juices, and catering; an opening timeline has not been announced.

location: 976 W Dorrell Ln, North Las Vegas, NV 89086
status: grand opening will take place on July 31 at 7 pm
short_description: Station Casinos is opening a new 24-hour Seventy Six Taverns at 976 W. Dorrell Ln. in North Las Vegas, with a ribbon-cutting on July 30 and public grand opening July 31. The Americana-style neighborhood tavern offers comfort food, handcrafted cocktails, 15 bartop gaming machines, and multiple TVs.

location: 6323 Camp Bowie Blvd #125, Fort Worth, TX 76116
status: final day of service set for July 31
short_description: The Basement Lounge, a cocktail bar open since 2015 at 6323 Camp Bowie Blvd #125 in Fort Worth, is closing on July 31 due to rising rent, insurance, and other operating costs. Owners Jesse Meráz and Christopher Neu announced the closure on Instagram and hope to bring a new concept to Fort Worth someday.
